issue: Molecules without structure (51 Unknown + 11 Antibody) and 2 peptides
proposed_action: Keep molecule_type == 'Small molecule'; do not impute

issue: Duplicate parent structures hidden by salts and solvents (21 groups)
proposed_action: Keep the largest fragment, neutralize, deduplicate on the parent InChIKey; re-attach the records of the merged forms

issue: ChEMBL molecular weight includes the counter-ion / solvent of the 49 salt forms (the other descriptors are computed on the parent)
proposed_action: Recompute the molecular weight on the parent structure (and, for consistency, all descriptors with RDKit)

issue: Several measurements per (molecule, kinase, type): 68% of the records
proposed_action: Aggregate per (molecule, kinase, type), e.g. median pChEMBL; never mix IC50, Ki and Kd

issue: Annotation records on molecules that will not be clustered (indications 224, mechanisms 72)
Raw columns with 15 unit spellings and 11 type spellings (conversions are consistent)
proposed_action: Use standard_type, standard_value and pchembl_value only; drop the raw columns

issue: Same (molecule, target) recorded as ANTAGONIST and INHIBITOR
Non-inhibitor mechanisms (2 negative allosteric modulators, 1 antagonist)
proposed_action: Keep but flag; check at interpretation time

issue: max_phase, first_approval, hbd, hba, rtb, aromatic_rings, ro5_violations hold whole numbers
proposed_action: Cast to integer (or Int64) after excluding the molecules without structure

issue: Inconsistent with the standard four-rule count
proposed_action: Drop the column (derived from other descriptors)
Keep as metadata; not a clustering feature
